Description

The 2015 Jeep Wrangler is the one car in our fleet that people take not instead of a taxi but for the sake of the drive itself. It is a proper body-on-frame off-roader: short overhangs, high clearance, a genuine low range. Where the tarmac ends it keeps going — towards Gomismta, towards Bakhmaro, over the Goderdzi pass, along the tracks of upper Adjara where an ordinary crossover is better left behind.

The roof and the doors come off — that is how the car is built, not an item on an options list. In summer on the coast it becomes an open car, and that, frankly, is the main reason people rent it.

In return you accept two things. An engine of three and a half litres drinks, especially in town. And the Wrangler is louder than anything else in the fleet: the frame, the chunky tyres, the upright windscreen. That is not a fault, that is its normal condition.

If you need a car to get from A to B, take a crossover. A Wrangler makes sense when B is a mountain.
